Quick technical update:

- Root cause (working hypothesis): a Skyline client SDK change iterated yesterday introduced aggressive retry behaviour when the backend began returning transient 503s under load. That combined with a lowered internal HTTP timeout in a recent runtime push allowed retries to pile up and starve the frontend queues — classic retry amplification.
- Evidence: request traces show identical payload IDs repeated in short windows (attached logs). We also see backend CPU saturating on a subset of shards.

Recommended next steps (actionable):
1) Apply a 2-minute server-side throttling rule to Skyline API key to break the retry loop.
2) Roll out a small runtime patch to restore previous timeout thresholds (rollback of the last timeout change) — safe to roll to 20% of serving nodes as canary. ETA: 3 hours to canary + monitor.
3) Increase dedicated worker pool by 2 nodes immediately; should restore throughput to ~90% within 30m.

I've uploaded the compressed logs (skyline_error_logs_0525.zip) to the incident folder. Marissa: confirm immediate capacity and any risk to other tenants.
